source: Version 1.9.0 separates Demand screening, scope-aware Supply comparison and eight research strategies. Strategies are evidence-backed survey queues after Demand, never Demand eligibility gates. At most three factor families, three metrics per joint rule and three strategies. Brand-specific unseen-context presets intentionally revise Demand paths; saved criteria win. Supply POIs are optional at every drilldown, coordinate coverage is separate from native totals, and clustered display is not evidence of shared customer visits. National source geography and exact DS assets remain pinned.
